# Grinder Maintenance

The shop grinder is a Mazzer with 64 mm flat burrs.

## Routine

Strip and brush the burrs every fortnight; oils from dark roasts go rancid and taint the next batch. Run a handful of rice-free cleaning tablets through it monthly.

## Replacing burrs

Replace the burrs after roughly 500 kg. Dull burrs make more fines and muddy cups.
